chapter: Image, travel and Black, Brown and Beige
title: Rising without a ceiling; Duke the dreamer
summary: Greer says nobody guessed how far the band would go and that Duke wrote his dreams.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Writing, arranging and composing: how the music gets made

blocks.x: When we got together, we had no idea, boy, up to no

no top. No way. Then after people started recognizing us, and our potentialities at the Kentucky Club, wasn't no looking back. You know, wasn't no looking back. And Duke was a dreamer. I often said -- guys would say, how did Duke come to write "Satin Doll" and "Mood Indigo" or "Sophisticated Lady"? I'd say, he's a dreamer, which he is. He could think of something and be sitting down in the dining room, kitchen, everywhere, and knock it down. Gone. That's right.
And all the guys, they have different ideas, they'd write them down or collaborate with Duke, and there, we're gone. So we always had fresh material.
